title: When you need clarity
line: For a decision, confusion, or a crossroads.
intro: Before a decision, this tradition asks for light on the mind: the Gayatri, the oldest prayer for understanding, and a few minutes of honest looking.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Sit comfortably, with your back upright and soft. Follow the circle: in as it grows, out as it settles. Never strain.

steps.title: Lead me to the light
steps.text: From untruth to truth, from darkness to light.

steps.title: The Gayatri
steps.text: Repeat the Gayatri slowly: may that light guide our understanding.

steps.title: The choice
steps.prompt: What are my choices? If I were not afraid, which would I choose, and why?

steps.title: Close
steps.text: Read the closing prayer once, slowly. Then sit for one more breath before you return to your day.

after: Sleep on it if you can. Clarity often comes after the practice, not during it.
